method: Actual browser output from unmodified public snapshots held for appearance comparison; the renderer runs. Portrait opens independently at its default low quality. No motion or frame-rate pass is implied. Guardian uses an explicit launchFloor=8 scenario.
initialCaptureSourceNote: Only scene.mjs changed during capture: landing cue cache key gained snapshot.worldWidth. The builder reproduced both recorded hashes by reversing that single prefix. Every captured fixture has worldWidth480000. Images remain first-pass evidence; the recorded initial/final hashes are retained.

captures.label: sentinel-strike
captures.probeMethod: Actual tick118 to tick119 attack edge, followed by one renderer callback (scene delta cap500ms; model delta cap100ms); callbacks held for pose inspection. This is a stepped pose, not live-motion evidence.

captures.label: retained-delay-phone
captures.probeMethod: Renderer callbacks paused after real pixels were submitted; network polling and true render-progress timeout continue. This verifies retained-delay layout, not a spontaneous driver stall.

blindComparison.limits: Whole-image comparisons; camera, cast and HUD changed together. The commercial reference remains preferred. No live-motion pass.
